# Leonie Kaiser – KI & Digitalisierung
# https://leoniekaiser.com

## About
Leonie Kaiser is an AI & digitalization expert based in Lower Austria (Niederösterreich),
specializing in AI strategy, EU AI Act compliance, GDPR-compliant setups, and process
automation for small, owner-led health practices (Wahlarzt/private-pay/self-pay) in the
DACH region (Austria, Germany, Switzerland).

## Services
- AI Potential Analysis (free 30-minute online consultation, no obligation)
- Strategy & roadmap, tailored to small private practices
- Process automation (No-Code), tool-agnostic, chosen per use case
- EU AI Act & GDPR compliance, part of every project rather than an add-on
- Implementation and team onboarding, no technical background required
- Optional ongoing support and maintenance

## Service areas
1. Appointments & enquiries — online booking, automated reminders, waiting-list
   refill, website chat assistant, e-mail assistant that sorts incoming enquiries
   by topic and urgency and prepares reply drafts, phone assistant for
   out-of-hours calls
2. Documentation & knowledge — structuring notes for review and release,
   template library, digital practice handbook for the team
3. Follow-up care & client retention — automated follow-up sequences,
   re-activation of former clients, review and referral requests
4. Visibility & content — brand voice definition, templates for social media and
   newsletters, AI drafts for recurring texts, machine-readable preparation of
   the website so AI assistants can read offer, catchment area and focus areas
   correctly (GEO)

Cross-cutting in every project: tool selection and integration into existing
systems, EU hosting or a local setup depending on data sensitivity, EU AI Act
risk classification and GDPR-compliant data flows.

## Packages
- Praxis-Start — EUR 1,490, up to three automations, freely combined across areas
- Praxis-Plus — EUR 2,900 to 5,900, several automations across areas, priced by scope
- Ongoing support — from EUR 190 per month, optional

## Expertise
- Strategy and digitalization for small, owner-led health practices
- EU AI Act compliance and ethical, human-centered AI deployment
- GDPR in practice: Art. 9 health data, processing records, data processing
  agreements, storage location, deletion periods, data subject rights
- Process automation and No-Code implementation, integrated into existing tools
- 20+ years experience in project management, product marketing and digitalization,
  including projects in healthcare, plus several years advising self-employed
  professionals
- Languages: German, English, Spanish

## Target audience
Small, owner-led private practices in health and prevention that rely (also) on
private-pay clients (Wahlarzt/self-pay), work with sensitive health data, and want
to digitalize without a technical background. Typically 2 to 10 employees. The
approach is problem-led rather than specialty-led: the same core bottlenecks
(appointments, follow-up care, documentation) occur across all specialties.

## Geography
Lower Austria (Niederösterreich) based, serving the DACH region and remote clients
